facts.text: The hotel is in the historic Galata district, where the Golden Horn meets the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: this historic district, where the Golden Horn meets the Bosphorus

facts.text: The hotel occupies the historic Baltazzi Han building in Galata.
facts.excerpt: reborn within the historic walls of Baltazzi Han, one of Galata’s most magnificent and rare buildings
one of Galata’s most magnificent and rare buildings dating back to 1836

facts.text: The hotel building was built in the late 19th century.
facts.excerpt: Built in the late 19th century, the historic bank building has been renovated

facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since 2018.
facts.excerpt: has been welcoming its guests with an unforgettable accommodation experience since 2018

facts.text: The Historical Cesme Hammam is hidden within the hotel's garden.
facts.excerpt: Hidden within the hotel’s garden, the Historical Cesme Hammam has been sharing the healing power of water
the Historical Cesme Hammam has been sharing the healing power of water since 1720

facts.text: The Historical Fountain Hammam was commissioned in the late 1720s.
facts.excerpt: The Historical Fountain Hammam, located within The Galata Istanbul Hotel MGallery, was commissioned in the late 1720s

facts.text: The hammam received World Luxury Spa Awards in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
facts.excerpt: Honored with the World Luxury SPA Awards in 2022 and 2023,2024 and 2025

facts.text: The hotel's restaurant serves modern and creative interpretations of Turkish cuisine.
facts.excerpt: you can discover modern and creative interpretations of Turkish cuisine

facts.text: In summer the restaurant has an open-air setting with views of the Golden Horn.
facts.excerpt: During the summer months, the open air setting with views of the Golden Horn offers a truly unique backdrop

facts.text: The hotel is on Bankalar Caddesi in Beyoglu, Istanbul.
facts.excerpt: Arap Camii Mahallesi Bankalar Caddesi No:21

facts.text: The hotel blends timeless heritage with contemporary elegance.
facts.excerpt: Blending timeless heritage with contemporary elegance, the hotel offers a unique sense of place

facts.text: The hotel is housed in a historic bank building.
The hotel's style is contemporary with distinctive Art Deco influences.
facts.excerpt: in a contemporary style with distinctive Art Deco influences
